en.topic_title: 3 women charged over play area brawl granted bail, banned from mall
en.topic_summary:
Three women arrested over an altercation in the play area of a Kwun Tong shopping centre last week have been granted bail after appearing in court.



Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Courts. Photo: GovHK. 



The defendants – 68-year-old Leung Lai-ha, her 34-year-old daughter Ng Ka-wun, and 34-year-old Xu Yang – made their first appearance at Kwun Tong Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday.
